lines: Before You Begin starts here with what your organization needs to know.
Each organization needs five officers and five more members.
The student who submits should send the guide to the other four officers.
The five officers must each complete the Commitment to Community Form.
Advisors complete their own training before December 1.
Frequently asked questions about the recognition process are below.
